capabilities.untrusted: In an untrusted workspace nothing runs: no Maven, no Gradle, no wrapper, no JDK manager. Detection reads files; every executing command is disabled with the reason.
config.jdk.sources: Where JDKs are looked for, in order. `mise` first because it is the manager every image this repository targets ships. Empty means: only what `java.configuration.runtimes` already lists.
config.jdk.installVia: Which manager installs a JDK: `auto` picks the first of `mise`, `sdkman` found; `none` disables the install offer. Absent: detected.
config.jdk.matchProject: Pick the runtime the build file asks for (`maven.compiler.release`, Gradle toolchain) rather than the newest installed.
config.generate.getterPrefix: Prefix of generated getters (honoured by the JDT bundle's generators).
config.generate.finalFields: Whether final fields still get a setter offered.
config.report.url: Where `Java: Report a problem` opens its prefilled issue. Empty: the issue template of batlehub-vsx on GitHub.
config.log.level: Verbosity of the `BatleHub Java` output channels.
config.statusBar.items: Satellite status bar items by id, `true` shown / `false` hidden. Absent: the satellite's own default.
config.resources.warnBelow: Container memory limit under which the status bar warns and the JDK tab explains what gets killed first. Empty disables.
config.inspections.enabled: Show the BatleHub inspections (JDT bundle) as diagnostics.
config.inspections.severityOverrides: Rule id → `error | warning | info | hint | off`, applied before display.
config.maven.configurations: Named Maven configurations (settings file, toolchains, home, env, default profiles). Absent: one per `~/.m2/settings*.xml`.
config.maven.activeConfiguration: The Maven configuration this workspace builds and imports with.
config.maven.activeProfiles: Profiles passed as `-P` to every goal and written where m2e reads them for the language server's import.
config.registry.enabled: Route Maven and Gradle through the BatleHub registry: `ask` once per workspace, `true`, or `false` (removes every trace).
config.registry.url: The BatleHub registry to route through. Empty: the one `batlehub-vsx` is signed into.
config.coexistence: Written by BatleHub Java: your answer to hiding the stock Java extensions' redundant views, per workspace.
config.experimental: Feature flags for what shipped before its phase declared it stable, e.g. `{ "intellijImport": true }`.
cmd.runGoal: Run a Maven goal / Gradle task…
view.welcome: Open a Maven or Gradle folder, or a Java file, and BatleHub Java activates.
task.goal: The goal(s) or task(s), e.g. "clean package" or "dependency:tree"
task.profiles: Maven profiles (-P); absent means the workspace's active profiles
cmd.maven.applyProfilesOverlay: Maven: apply the profiles through a settings overlay (fallback)
cmd.maven.effectivePom: Maven: effective POM (diff against the raw one)
view.inspections.welcome:
The BatleHub inspections run inside the Java language server (Standard mode) once its bundle is loaded — it loads at server start.
[Restart the Java language server](command:batlehub.java.restartServer)
